notes: All three margins were read and set aside; the printed text governs under rule 38.

לֹא … דָבָר → 'nothing' is retained as one unit: the single word carries both the negation and the indefinite noun, which is rule 35's fusion, headed on the negative, while הָיָה keeps its own presentative 'there was'.
In שֶׁמֶן הַטּוֹב the one article morpheme takes the single written 'the' before a supplied one, under rules 29 and 47.
The closing waw takes 'nor' under rule 14; no second negative morpheme stands in that clause for the word to rest on.
